limitations: Native process end-to-end includes process startup and IPC; the local Rust C ABI metabolism adapter is not a full-simulation backend.
The Rust child peak RSS is measured with GNU time in a separate invocation. JS heap delta is retained output memory, not peak allocation.
structuredClone is only a transfer proxy here. The bounded Worker benchmark measures actual message transfer and journal/storage costs separately.
The Modal backend is a candidate only; no remote execution was made and no remote latency/cost is reported.
